AudioEnhancement.Title: Sound Management
AudioEnhancement.Intro: Audio enhancement presets, inspired by FXSound's approach: system-wide via Equalizer APO (if installed) + a live visualizer (WASAPI loopback) on the Audio Enhancement widget.
AudioEnhancement.ApoFound: Equalizer APO detected — presets are genuinely applied to all applications.
AudioEnhancement.ApoMissing: Equalizer APO not detected — without it, presets only enhance the visualizer, not real playback. Free, open-source, safe.
AudioEnhancement.PresetsNote: Flat · Bass Boost · Treble Boost · Vocal Boost · Loudness (bass+treble together, FXSound-style "Loudness").

Settings.Intro: Global settings for appearance, language, snapping, startup and app behavior.
Dashboard.Intro: Your desktop, organized into one lightweight workspace hub.
Widgets.Intro: Native widgets are lightweight. WebView2 is reserved for rich HTML/video widgets.
DeskZones.Intro: FancyZones-style zones (PowerToys): hold Shift while dragging any window to see the screen's zones, and drop it inside one to snap it to that size automatically.
DeskZones.ShiftDragHint: Without Shift, dragging windows works exactly as normal — no interference. Each screen's layout is set here, not per individual zone.
DeskZones.KeyboardAndNeighborHint: Ctrl+Alt+Shift+arrow moves the active window to the next zone; Ctrl+Shift+arrow (no Alt) moves only the focus, without moving any window. Resizing an already-snapped window by dragging its edge now also resizes its snapped neighbor to match.
DeskZones.ContainersIntro: Drag files or folders into a container to group them visually on the desktop. Press Space (or right-click → Quick Look) on an icon for a quick preview.
DeskZones.QuickHideDoubleClick: Double-click an empty spot on the desktop to hide/show desktop icons
DeskContainer.SortingRulesInfo: Only one sorting criterion is supported at a time (the "Sort by" menu). Complex, multi-level sorting rules (e.g. by file type AND then by name) aren't available yet.
Wallpaper.Intro: One engine for live (video playlist) or procedural (Opsis Waves) backgrounds, with performance modes and automatic battery savings.
Wallpaper.SupportedFormats: Supported formats: MP4, M4V, WebM, MOV, OGV, OGG, AVI, MKV, WMV, MPEG, MPG, M2TS, TS. Anything that can't play (e.g. an exotic codec in AVI/WMV) is automatically skipped to the next one.
Wallpaper.PerScreenNote: A screen with a pinned video doesn't take part in the shared playlist's shuffle/advance.
Wallpaper.AudioNote: Real equalizer applied only to the wallpaper video's own audio — doesn't affect other applications' sound.
Profiles.Intro: Save your entire desktop setup and load it back with one click.
Performance.Intro: Live hardware overview, without a separate PerformanceCounter per widget.
Automation.Intro: Rules like: when an application starts → load a workspace profile.
About.Body: This build uses a real application shell while desktop overlays remain independently managed.
About.CapabilitiesList: Native widgets • snap-to-grid • multi-monitor recovery • DeskZone layouts • live wallpaper • audio visualizer • profiles • automation • command palette • tray integration • global hotkeys • battery-aware performance modes • light/dark theme • 14 languages.
About.ShortcutsList:
# Navigation
Ctrl+1…9  Go to page (menu order)
Ctrl+0  Personalization (IconAtlas/DeskCursors/DeskStrip/DeskSounds)
Ctrl+K  Command Palette
Ctrl+B  Collapse/expand the sidebar
Ctrl+,  Settings
F1  About Opsis - Desktop Customization
F5  Refresh the current page
# Actions
Ctrl+E  Enable/Disable the wallpaper
Ctrl+Shift+N  New DeskZone
Shift  While dragging a window: show DeskZones and snap into one
# Global (work in any app)
Ctrl+Alt+F  DeskFlip (window switcher)
Ctrl+Alt+G  Toggle Gaming/Work profile
Ctrl+Alt+M  Show the main window
Ctrl+Alt+Shift+←  Move the active window to the left DeskZone
Ctrl+Alt+Shift+→  Move the active window to the right DeskZone

About.InstructionsList:
1. Widgets: go to the "Widgets" page and pick one to spawn it on the desktop. Drag its title bar to move it, ☰ for options, 🔒/🔓 to lock its position, ✕ to close.
2. DeskZones: Ctrl+Shift+N opens the zone layout editor; hold Shift while dragging any window to snap it into a zone.
3. DeskContainers: tray menu → add a container, then drag files/folders onto it to group them.
4. Wallpaper: go to the "Wallpaper" page, add a video and enable it. Playback automatically pauses when another app goes fullscreen.
5. Personalization: the "Personalization" page (Ctrl+0) covers system icons/cursors/sounds.
6. The tray icon (bottom-right, next to the clock) gives quick access to profiles, wallpaper and settings without opening the main window.
About.PluginUninstallConfirmBody: Remove {0}? This deletes its files. You can reinstall it later from its own installer.
About.PluginUninstallQueued: Plugin stopped - its files will be fully removed the next time Opsis starts.
About.LicenseSummary: Free and open-source software under the MIT License — free to use, modify and redistribute, provided "as is" with no warranty. Full license text and third-party components are listed in the LICENSE file in the install folder.
Common.NoPinnedApps: No pinned apps yet — drag one onto the dock, or use "Pin application…".
Personalization.Intro: The safe, registry/native-API-only pieces of the customization vision — no system files are modified. Everything here is reversible with the Reset/Clear buttons.
Personalization.IconAtlasIntro: Change the icon for This PC and the Recycle Bin (empty/full), or set a custom icon for any folder — the same desktop.ini mechanism Explorer itself uses.
Personalization.IconPackFolderPrompt: Choose a folder with .ico files (e.g. name-empty.ico / name-full.ico)
Personalization.IconPackSingleApplied: Found one .ico — applied to This PC.
Personalization.IconPackNotFound: No .ico files matching the "-empty"/"-full" convention were found in this folder.
Personalization.DeskCursorsIntro: Assign a custom cursor per role. Roles left unset keep whatever Windows is already using — nothing is overwritten unless you pick a file for it.
Personalization.DeskStripIntro: A floating dock of pinned apps, bottom-center of your primary screen. Drag a file onto it, or use "Pin application…". Auto-hide isn't built yet — see the roadmap.
Personalization.DeskSoundsIntro: Assign a custom .wav per system event — the same official mechanism as the classic Windows Sound scheme picker.
Personalization.ThemePackagesIntro: Windows' own theme package format — bundles wallpaper, cursors and sound scheme into one file, applied through Windows' own theme handler. Not a visual-style engine: window/button shapes aren't changed.
Personalization.LockScreenIntro: Uses the same Personalization CSP mechanism MDM/Intune tools use. Requires an administrator prompt (writes to a machine-wide setting) — asked for fresh each time, only for this one action.
Personalization.LockScreenEditionNote: Detected edition: {0}. This is documented to work on Pro/Enterprise/Education; on Home edition Windows may silently ignore it.
Personalization.LockScreenFailed: Could not confirm the change took effect (possibly ignored by this Windows edition).
Personalization.LockScreenNeedsWallpaper: Turn on the animated wallpaper first.
Personalization.LockScreenCaptureFailed: Could not capture a snapshot of the wallpaper.
Personalization.ResetLockScreenImage: Reset to Windows' default lock screen
Personalization.LockScreenResetSuccess: Reset done — Windows will show its own choice again.
Settings.UiSoundCues: UI sound cues (system sounds on key actions)
Settings.WallpaperNote: Video playlist, Opsis Waves themes and performance modes are configured on the Wallpaper Studio page.
Settings.AutoPerformanceMode: Automatically use Battery/Low Power wallpaper mode

VersionNotes.1.6.2:
+ FancyWM-style keyboard zone navigation (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Arrow — plain Ctrl+Alt+Arrow turned out to be already reserved by graphics drivers on many machines): moves the active window to the neighboring DeskZone without a mouse.
~ Real language flag icons (instead of Unicode emoji that rendered as "GR"/"GB").
~ Fixed a real bug where the wallpaper playlist could get stuck after the first transition instead of advancing video by video (race condition in the crossfade between two video layers).
= Confirmed live that automatic .wmv→.mp4 conversion and importing several videos at once work correctly.
~ "About" moved below "Sound Management" in the menu.
~ The Command Palette is now fully translated (it always showed English before, regardless of language).
VersionNotes.1.6.1:
= Performance + translation completion.
+ The "Performance" page gained a GPU meter (load/temperature, the same live hardware sensor as the System Monitor widget) next to CPU/Memory.
= Confirmed that the hitch when opening the System Monitor widget was already fixed (GPU sensors warm up on a background thread).
~ Finished the Greek/English translation of the Widgets, Profiles, Automation, Personalization, Settings and Performance pages — verified live by switching language in both directions.
VersionNotes.1.6.0:
= Stability + DeskZones snap engine.
~ Fixed a crash loop in Audio Enhancement (a leaked Timer after changing page — SetPage now properly disposes the old page).
+ New: a real equalizer (bass/mid/treble/volume) on the wallpaper video's own audio via the Web Audio API — no external tool, other apps' audio is unaffected.
~ Disks widget: the ring is no longer overlapped by the ◀/▶ buttons and the text inside the ring now shrinks automatically to always fit.
~ Partial fix of mixed Greek/English text (tray menu, Control Panel, some dialogs) so they follow the selected language.
~ DeskZones: the whole window-snapping engine was rebuilt — instead of the old unreliable heuristic on a raw mouse hook it now uses the documented Windows signal (SetWinEventHook/EVENT_SYSTEM_MOVESIZESTART) that tells accessibility tools when a window move really started.
~ Fixed a real zone-geometry bug where zones touching a screen edge never reached the actual edge.
~ The zone overlay is now truly translucent (per-pixel alpha layered window instead of an opaque chroma key).
+ New: AquaSnap-style magnetic snap — without Shift, dragging a window near a screen edge/corner previews a half/quarter-screen snap; the full DeskZones grid still requires Shift.
VersionNotes.1.5.0:
= Big pass based on user feedback.
~ DeskZones: fixed a bug where choosing the number of rows/columns in a preset always applied a full grid instead of clean rows/columns; snap-to-zone now stretches windows to the real screen edges (compensating the invisible DWM border).
+ DeskContainers: double-click the title to rename.
+ Widgets: Clock with analog themes (Classic/Neon/Minimal) + digital font/color; Disks rebuilt as one ring per drive with ◀/▶ paging; new "TechGrid" wallpaper style (circuit board, tech theme).
+ Wallpaper: smooth crossfade between videos (no black/white flash), load playlists from .zip/.7z, per-video enable checkbox in the library.
+ New "Sound Management" page (formerly Audio Visualizer): real system-wide audio enhancement through Equalizer APO integration (open source, already signed) when installed — Flat/Bass Boost/Treble Boost/Vocal Boost/Loudness presets plus a live visualizer.
~ The "Help" page was merged into About (duplicate information).
+ Added a "System dependencies" section in Settings (FFmpeg/WebView2 Runtime, installable via winget).
~ The license button now shows the license text in an in-app window (it used to open the Windows "Open with" picker because LICENSE has no extension).
+ Added PE metadata (Company/Copyright/Description) to reduce antivirus false positives.
VersionNotes.1.4.1:
~ SERIOUS fix for the animated wallpaper, especially on Windows 11: on the newer "raised desktop" layout (Progman with WS_EX_NOREDIRECTIONBITMAP, Windows 11 24H2+) the classic 0x052C message that asks Progman to create the sibling WorkerW behind the icons does nothing — it needs wParam=0xD, lParam=1.
= Without it the attach never found a separate WorkerW and always fell back to the Progman path, which explained why the problem persisted.
~ Added explicit detection of this layout and both message variants are now sent.
~ The "SetParent succeeded" check now uses GetAncestor(GA_PARENT) instead of GetParent (GetParent can return the owner instead of the parent for WS_POPUP windows).
~ Bug fix: the "Disks" widget did not fill its own background on each drive row (it showed as a light-gray box in the dark theme) — it now fills UiTheme.Surface like everything else.
= Investigated whether the K-Lite codec pack would help with .wmv: it would not — Chromium/WebView2 uses its own FFmpeg-based media pipeline that never goes through system DirectShow/Media Foundation filters.
= FFmpeg (already used by the conversion service) has its own VC-1/WMV3 decoder — only FFmpeg itself needs to be present.
VersionNotes.1.4.0:
= Big pass based on detailed user feedback.
+ Clock: the time is now truly centered in the widget (both variants), a separate date line under the analog clock, new 12/24-hour format and show/hide seconds options in the ☰ menu.
+ System Monitor: added Network and GPU (load/voltage/temperature, via the open-source LibreHardwareMonitorLib) — text is no longer cut off (Dock=Fill instead of a fixed height).
+ Weather: humidity percentage and Beaufort scale next to wind speed, a larger animated weather icon.
+ New "Disks" widget (usage/capacity of every drive).
+ Audio Visualizer: a second "Winamp" style (gradient bars + reflection) next to "WMP Legacy", selectable from the ☰ menu.
+ Drag & drop of files/folders on ALL widgets (previously only DeskContainers).
+ DeskContainers can now be locked in place (🔒/🔓, like widgets) and are remembered/reopened every session together with widgets.
~ Autostart with Windows now opens in the background (tray icon only, no main window) when widgets/DeskContainers are saved.
~ SERIOUS bug fixed in the live theme-darkness preview: the slider only updated owner-drawn parts live (sidebar/logo), not the main content, until released — now the whole window updates live; SuspendLayout/DoubleBuffered added around full page rebuilds to remove momentary white squares.
+ New "Instructions" and "License" sections in About (previously only shortcuts) — a LICENSE (MIT) file was added.
~ The installer (Inno Setup) now follows the GearWin structure: an "Information" page before installing, a mandatory license page and an update-detected message.
+ Double-click an empty spot on the desktop to hide/restore all icons except This PC / user folder / Control Panel / Recycle Bin (Stardock Fences style) — needs testing on a real desktop.
~ DeskFlip: rebuilt as a real diagonal depth stack with a perspective-warp effect on the windows behind the selected one (a true live 3D render is not possible from public APIs).
+ .wmv is now converted AUTOMATICALLY to .mp4 through FFmpeg (WmvConversionService) before it is added to Wallpaper Studio, instead of a plain warning — if FFmpeg is not found, its download page can be opened right away.
~ DeskContainer ☰ menu rebuilt to match the real Stardock Fences structure.
~ The double-click that hides desktop icons now also hides/restores DeskContainers (except those with "Exclude from quick-hide"), like the real Fences.
+ Icon pack import (depot) for Recycle Bin icons.
+ Wallpaper Waves/Aurora/Particles: width/glow/speed now truly react to the system audio level (fast attack, slow release), not only the separate radial glow overlay that already existed.
VersionNotes.1.3.0:
~ Full pass over the native widgets (Clock/Network/Audio Visualizer/Weather) — no longer just black: a themed, rounded shell that reacts live to theme/darkness changes.
+ Clock: Digital/Analog choice (hand-drawn analog clock) from the ☰ menu.
+ Network: a live download/upload mini-sparkline under the stats.
~ Audio Visualizer: the ASCII text was replaced by a real multi-band equalizer (WASAPI loopback + FFT through NAudio.Dsp, an existing dependency) in WMP Legacy style — segmented LED bars with a slowly falling peak-hold cap.
+ Weather: location picker (☰ menu → "Set location…", geocoding via Open-Meteo), hand-drawn animated weather icons per condition (sun with rotating rays, cloud, falling rain/snow, lightning) and an automatic fallback to a second free provider (wttr.in, no API key) if Open-Meteo fails.
~ SERIOUS bug fixed: the weather URL was built with floating-point numbers without InvariantCulture — in cultures with a decimal comma (e.g. el-GR) 37.9838 became "37,9838", Open-Meteo silently returned a JSON error (not an HTTP error) and the widget showed "Weather unavailable" forever without logging any exception.
VersionNotes.1.2.9:
~ Critical fix for the animated wallpaper (Waves/Particles/Video), borrowed from how Lively Wallpaper does it: the WinForms wallpaper window is always created with the native WS_POPUP style, even with FormBorderStyle.None.
= SetParent to WorkerW/Progman only changed the logical parent — it did NOT convert WS_POPUP to WS_CHILD, so on many Windows 10/11 builds the window did not take part correctly in the new parent's compositing/z-order (staying invisible or acting like a screensaver over the desktop) even when SetParent technically succeeded.
~ An explicit WS_POPUP→WS_CHILD conversion (SetWindowLongPtr + SWP_FRAMECHANGED) is now done before every SetParent.
= Confirmed live that the window now becomes a real child of Progman at the correct screen size.
VersionNotes.1.2.8:
~ UI polish pass: Greek capitals in section/card titles no longer carry accents (correct orthographic convention).
~ All HoverButtons in the app became fully rounded "pills" globally, using the same mechanism (Selectable=false) that fixed the visible focus-rectangle bug on the DeskZones editor's PillButton.
~ The DeskSounds buttons (Browse/Preview/Clear) were clipping text — wider and moved to the right.
~ Bug fix: while the user was on "Lock screen background", the page auto-scrolled back to DeskSounds every 2 seconds — the DeskStrip periodic timer rebuilt its own list inside an auto-scroll container, silently resetting the PAGE's scroll position. Fixed by saving/restoring the scroll position around each refresh.
VersionNotes.1.2.7:
+ DeskZones are now REALLY FancyZones-style (after screenshots of the actual PowerToys editor) — no more permanently visible bordered windows on the desktop.
+ Hold Shift while dragging a window to see the zones and snap (without Shift, dragging is completely normal).
+ New layout editor (Ctrl+Shift+N) with 7 templates (No layout/Focus/Columns/Rows/Grid/Priority Grid/Custom) — adjustable columns/rows ONLY in Custom, the presets keep a fixed shape.
~ A SERIOUS bug was found and fixed before release: a self-referential Click handler caused infinite recursion on every click on a template card — a StackOverflowException, uncatchable in .NET, that terminated the whole app without any exception log.
~ Also fixed a separate bug in the parameter mapping of the "Rows" template (it read the wrong variable for the row count) and a visual bug where the keyboard focus rectangle of a rounded "pill" button stuck out of its rounded outline.
VersionNotes.1.2.6:
~ Bugfix pass after reports: DeskZones "opened by themselves" at startup — caused by a polluted saved "Last Session" profile from internal test runs, now cleaned; the smoke-test script now cleans up its own test zones.
~ Removed the Fences-style roll-up/hover-collapse from DeskZones — their real behavior (snap-on-drop, FancyZones style) was already correct.
~ Fixed a SERIOUS bug where enabling the wallpaper (especially the first time in a fresh session) blocked the UI thread for up to ~8.5 seconds per screen (WorkerW attach retry loop) — the whole app "froze". It now runs on a background thread.
~ The Video Library/Theme & Colors/Wave Tuning sections of the Wallpaper page were ALWAYS visible regardless of the selected Mode — they now appear only when relevant.
~ Fixed a bug where switching Dark→Light "did not respond" (re-entrancy in the theme dropdown popup).
~ Fixed "flicker" on the theme darkness slider — live preview without page rebuild, full application only on release.
~ The version history was cutting text on long entries — cards now take the real height they need.
+ The latest version in the history now stands out with a colored frame.
VersionNotes.1.2.5:
+ New "Dark theme intensity" slider in Settings (0-100%, 50% = the unchanged original base) — live preview while you drag, like the existing Window Opacity.
~ A bug was found and fixed before release: the first implementation made all layers (background/sidebar/cards/hover/borders) converge to identical pure black at 100% — each layer now has its own explicit "floor" color, keeping visual separation across the whole range.
VersionNotes.1.2.4:
+ Completed the "partially feasible" items of the Customization Vision on the Personalization page: .theme packages (a gallery of ready-made Windows themes + saving the current setup as a new .theme, through the OS's own handler) and the lock screen background (Personalization CSP, with elevation only for that single action — never a whole elevated launch of the app).
= The installer was compiled for the first time explicitly on request.
VersionNotes.1.2.3:
+ New "Personalization" page (Ctrl+0) with the safe (registry/native API only) parts of the Customization Vision — all names were checked for trademark conflicts before being chosen: IconAtlas (This PC / Recycle Bin empty-full / per-folder icons), DeskCursors (custom mouse pointer scheme), DeskStrip (floating dock of pinned apps with a live "running now" indicator), DeskSounds (a full system sound scheme beyond the stock cues).
= A visual-style engine and restoring the classic Start Menu/taskbar were considered and explicitly ruled out — both would require patching protected system files.
VersionNotes.1.2.2:
~ Sidebar nav tooltips now always show the keyboard shortcut (e.g. "Widgets (Ctrl+2)"), not just in collapsed mode.
+ New Quick Look preview for DeskContainers — press Space or right-click → Quick Look on a file icon to instantly preview images and text files, or browse a folder's contents, without opening any external app.
VersionNotes.1.2.1:
~ Flip 3D: real keyboard cycling (←/→/Tab/Enter), angled tilted-card layout with the selected window centered.
~ Fixed the sidebar logo showing a stray gray box in compact mode and added a glossy highlight.
~ DeskZones layouts now cover every connected screen, not just the primary one.
+ Wallpaper auto-pauses when another app goes fullscreen.
+ Keyboard shortcuts for every major function (Ctrl+1…9 navigate pages, Ctrl+K palette, Ctrl+B collapse sidebar, Ctrl+E toggle wallpaper, Ctrl+Shift+N new DeskZone — full list in About).
+ Uninstaller now offers to remove saved settings.
~ Installer explicitly declared x64-only.
VersionNotes.1.2.0:
+ DeskZones reworked as FancyZones-style window snapping (drag any window into a zone to fill it); new DeskContainers feature for grouping files/folders/shortcuts on the desktop.
~ Fixed the wallpaper hiding desktop icons when the WorkerW attach silently failed.
~ Custom rounded dropdowns everywhere (replacing classic ComboBoxes) — and fixed a real crash where opening one closed instantly (context-menu disposal bug affecting every popup menu in the app).
+ Collapsible sidebar (icon-only, animated, square tiles).
+ Window opacity setting.
+ Animated wave header background.
+ Sparkline charts for Network/Processes.
~ Nav reorder, bigger logo/title with version number, active-state highlighting on toggle buttons, more icons app-wide.
VersionNotes.1.1.2:
~ Fixed a real crash where creating any DeskZone layout threw a NullReferenceException.
~ Vector icons (no font-glyph dependency) across the sidebar and Widget Gallery.
~ Removed duplicate page titles app-wide.
~ Merged Performance/System Monitor into one tab.
+ Widgets and DeskZones now both show visible ✕ close and ☰ settings-menu buttons instead of relying on right-click.
VersionNotes.1.1.1: ~ Fixed Dashboard sidebar entry being invisible (Home icon added), richer gradient/glow wallpaper wave rendering, Performance page redesigned as a distinct wallpaper-performance control center (no longer duplicates System Monitor's live stats).
VersionNotes.1.1.0: + Theme system (Light/Dark/Follow Windows), localization (EL/EN), colored System Monitor meters, DeskZones/Profiles two-column layouts with layout icons, visible widget Close/Lock buttons, animated sidebar logo, fixed invisible-text rendering bugs (NavButton, StatCard).
VersionNotes.1.0.0: + Initial unified build: Dashboard, Widget Gallery, DeskZones, Wallpaper Studio (video playlist + Opsis Waves), System Monitor, Profiles, Performance, Automation, Command Palette, tray integration, global hotkeys.

VersionNotes.1.6.8:
= Major stability and performance audit (includes all intermediate changes 1.6.3–1.6.7).
+ Single instance only: launching the app again focuses the running one.
+ New "Minimize to tray" option in Settings (the ✕ button hides the app to the tray).
+ .wmv→.mp4 conversion now also applies when adding a whole folder.
~ Decorative animations and widgets stop while the window is hidden or a fullscreen app is active.
~ The wallpaper fully suspends when disabled.
~ One shared WASAPI audio capture for all audio features; a shared process cache.
~ Debounced display changes and wallpaper sliders.
~ Memory/GDI leaks fixed (lists rebuilt every 2s, icons, paths, processes).
~ The ✕ button hides the app to the tray instead of destroying it (hotkeys and DeskZones keep working).
~ Hidden desktop icons are restored on exit.
~ Atomic settings saving (no more loss on concurrent reads); "Last Session" is saved before widgets close.
~ Automation applies a profile only when the process starts; loading a profile no longer changes language/theme.
~ Multi-monitor: correct playlist advance, safe magnetic snap at monitor borders.
~ More robust .wmv→.mp4 conversion (no hangs on large files, no corrupt partial files, odd dimensions handled); 7z extraction without freezing.
~ Translations: complete version history and ~100 more strings (widget/container menus, dialogs, file filters, installer) in Greek and English.
~ Security: hardened WebView2 (local pages only, no DevTools/external navigation).
VersionNotes.1.7.5:
= Big feature release: a weather and time-of-day wallpaper, a smarter wallpaper playlist, a redesigned Version History, and many improvements to DeskZones, DeskContainers and Performance.
+ New "Weather" wallpaper mode: a procedural scene that follows the real time of day (sunrise, sunset, moon phase, stars) and the live weather of your location — clouds, high-fidelity rain with ripples and splashes, snow, fog and thunderstorms with lightning. Pick your city, or preview any weather/time manually.
+ Optional raindrops on a window pane (with a refraction effect) while it rains.
+ Weather wallpaper: optional time, date and temperature on screen, with a position, size and °C/°F that you choose (default: centred in the upper third).
+ Wallpaper playlist: video thumbnails and durations, "Select all / none" and a "Remove missing files" button.
+ Wallpaper playlist: play each video N times, or switch to the next video every N minutes.
+ "Include subfolders" option when adding a folder of videos.
+ Wallpaper schedule: switch the wallpaper mode automatically by time of day (up to 3 time windows).
+ Version History redesigned like GearWin: the current release highlighted, a count of additions and improvements for every release, older releases expand on click.
+ Keyboard shortcuts in one tidy card with grouped keycaps — now including the global Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Arrow zone shortcuts.
+ DeskZones: a list of applications that never snap, and zone numbers in the snap preview.
+ DeskContainers: item count in the title, "Find in container…" and an auto-collect rule that gathers desktop files by type.
+ Performance: CPU/RAM and GPU history graphs, top 5 memory users and an optional notification when CPU or memory stays above 90% for a minute.
+ Update check (once a day, from GitHub releases) and the changelog opens once after an update.
+ Wallpaper attach log (wallpaper-attach.log) to diagnose the intermittent "wallpaper not visible after boot" problem.
+ Every settings file now keeps an automatic .bak copy and is restored from it if it gets damaged.
+ Weather wallpaper: the wind (Beaufort scale) now drives the sea — mirror-calm at Bf 1-2, gentle ripples, choppy water with whitecaps from Bf 5 — and the speed of the clouds; the wind can also be previewed manually.
~ Weather wallpaper: clouds get denser, lower and darker when it rains, with a heavy overcast deck in downpours.
~ Weather wallpaper water redesigned: a soft rippling reflection plus a shimmering sun/moon light path (no mirrored disc, no banding).
~ Shuffle plays every active video once before repeating any (it used to be pure random with repeats).
~ Ticking or removing a video no longer changes the video that is currently playing.
~ The wallpaper status no longer shows "inactive" for a moment when the app opens.
~ RAM usage also shows as a percentage (dashboard, status bar, Performance page, System Monitor widget).
~ The Opsis window itself now snaps into DeskZones (it was excluded together with the widgets).
~ DeskContainers: double-click on the title now renames (the native window drag swallowed the double-click); the title is centered in a taller bar with its own accent-tinted background, like Fences.
~ DeskZones layouts follow their monitor when Windows renumbers the displays after a reconnect.
VersionHistory.Subtitle: What was added and improved in every release. Click an older version to expand it.
Wallpaper.WeatherIntro: The wallpaper follows the real time of day (sunrise, sunset, moon phase, stars) and the live weather of your location: clouds, rain, snow, fog and thunderstorms. Weather comes from Open-Meteo and refreshes every 10 minutes.
Wallpaper.WeatherLiveUnavailable: Live weather is unavailable (offline?). A clear sky is shown; the time of day still works.
Wallpaper.WeatherLocationNotFound: City not found — check the name and your connection.
Wallpaper.WeatherLocationPromptBody: Opsis is currently showing weather for Athens (the default) since no city is set. Set your real location now?
Wallpaper.WeatherGlass: Raindrops on the window glass (while it rains)
Wallpaper.IncludeSubfolders: Include subfolders when adding a folder
Wallpaper.ScheduleNote: Switch the wallpaper mode automatically by the clock — for example calm waves during the day and the weather scene at night. Windows may wrap past midnight. The schedule only changes the mode; it never turns the wallpaper on by itself.
DeskContainer.FindPrompt: Show only the items whose name contains:
DeskContainer.AutoCollectPrompt: File types to collect from the desktop into this container automatically (for example: pdf, docx, xlsx). Existing and new desktop files of these types are added; the files themselves are not moved. Leave empty to turn the rule off.
DeskZones.ExcludedAppsHint: Windows of these applications are ignored by DeskZones (for example a video player or a game). One process name per line, as shown in Task Manager without ".exe" (e.g. vlc, obs64).
Performance.AlertsEnable: Notify me when CPU or memory stays above 90% for a minute
Alert.CpuHigh: The CPU has been above 90% for over a minute.
Alert.RamHigh: Memory has been above 90% for over a minute. Biggest user: {0}.
Alert.Title: Opsis — high usage
Update.Available: Version {0} is available. Click to open the download page.
Update.Title: Opsis update
About.UpdateAuto: Check for a new version at startup and periodically
About.UpdateFailed: Could not check (offline, or no release is published yet).
About.UpdateDependenciesMissing: Missing: {0}. Install them from Settings → System dependencies.
About.UpdateConfirm: Download and install version {0}? Opsis will close automatically to finish installing, then reopen.
About.UpdateScheduled: Downloaded and verified. Opsis will close now to finish installing, then reopen.
About.UpdateVerifyFailed: The downloaded file did not match the published checksum — deleted, nothing was installed. Please try again later.
About.UpdateNoDigest: This release has no checksum to verify against, so nothing is installed automatically — opening the release page instead.
Wallpaper.WeatherInfo: Show time, date and temperature on the wallpaper
Wallpaper.InfoIntro: Shows the time, date and temperature on the wallpaper. It works over any wallpaper — your own videos, Waves, Particles, the Weather scene and even your normal static Windows wallpaper. Choose your city, the font and where the text sits on the screen.
Wallpaper.InfoAllModes: Also show it over videos, the other wallpaper modes and my normal Windows wallpaper
VersionNotes.1.7.6:
= Small release: the clock, date and temperature now show over every wallpaper — including your normal static Windows wallpaper.
+ The time, date and temperature overlay can be shown over your own videos, Waves and Particles — not only the Weather scene — with the same position, size and °C/°F settings.
+ New "Desktop" mode that shows your normal Windows wallpaper (static picture or slideshow); it starts by itself when the animated wallpaper is off and the overlay is on, so the clock, date and temperature are always there.
+ Choose the font of the overlay (common Windows fonts, plus "More fonts…" for any installed font).
+ A new "Clock, date and temperature" section on the Wallpaper page (all modes) with the location, live weather and the overlay options in one place.
~ The overlay shows the real time and the live temperature in the non-Weather modes (the weather/time/wind previews apply only to the Weather scene).
~ The reset button is now simply "Reset position" and only resets the position.
~ Fewer flickers at startup: the wallpaper window is revealed only when its first frame is ready (no black rectangle), windows are no longer rebuilt after a display notification that changed nothing, a rebuild keeps the old wallpaper until the new one is visible, and the clock block no longer jumps when the temperature arrives.
~ The live weather is read without blocking (cache + background refresh with retries), so it also works reliably through the WebView2 bridge.
VersionNotes.2.2.0:
+ DeskContainers, with features ported from the open-source Desktop Fences + (MIT): auto-hide after inactivity, Chameleon (container colour follows the wallpaper), daily automatic backup with restore, container import/export, Peek Behind (hide a container for 10 s), Clear dead shortcuts, "Run as administrator / as different user" in the item menu, and an optional SpotSearch (Ctrl+`) to search and launch items across all containers.
+ New DeskContainers section in the DeskZones page for these settings. Credits: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
VersionNotes.2.1.3:
~ Widgets (Clock, Network, Weather, Disk, Quick Settings, Calendar…): text is now drawn by a transparency-friendly control (grey anti-aliasing + a subtle shadow) instead of Windows labels that left black fringes on full transparency.
~ Network widget: the history graph fills from the right like the System Monitor (it looked like a vertical line during the first samples).
~ Clock: fixed a bug that drew a red ✕ instead of the time when the clock font was reloaded.
VersionNotes.2.1.2:
~ Double-click hide-icons: the Recycle Bin, Control Panel, This PC and the user folder now stay visible — also on Greek Windows (names come from the shell, not from a fixed list).
+ New "Icons that stay visible…" button (desktop settings): choose which icons remain when the desktop is hidden.
~ Wallpaper Enable/Disable: Disable now works with ONE click (it used to need 2-3 while a window reveal was pending).
VersionNotes.2.1.1:
+ The installer now offers "Download and install Opsis Appearance" (a plugin to change the look of Windows, with a Theme Manager) — optional, not ticked by default.
+ Personalization → Themes: a new "Open Theme Manager" button that opens the Opsis Appearance Theme Manager (or its download page when it is not installed).
~ Personalization → "Save current theme": the .theme file now also records the dark/light mode and the accent colour. Before, applying a saved theme turned Windows back to light with the default accent.
~ The installers are now built with Inno Setup 7 and bundle their own Greek.isl.
VersionNotes.2.1.0:
+ New DeskStrip (a SeelenUI-style dock): also shows RUNNING apps with an active-window indicator, icon magnification on hover, live window previews, auto-hide from the screen edge, 4 positions (bottom/top/left/right), a menu (new window, run as administrator, file location, close, pin) and drag to reorder.
+ DeskContainers (Fences): Folder Portals (a container shows a folder live, with sub-folder navigation), icon size and labels, multi-select, moving items between containers, an item menu, and snapping to screen edges/other containers.
+ Audio Enhancement: a 10-band equalizer for ALL system audio through Equalizer APO, the 16 Waveframe presets, your own presets, import/export (Equalizer APO .txt or Waveframe preset JSON).
+ System Monitor: new look with a card per metric and a 2-minute history graph; in "Full transparency" it shows only the information, no box.
+ New diagnostics tool: Opsis.exe --diag [--show-desktop] (Windows build, WebView2, desktop window tree, a real wallpaper test, weather, plugins).
+ New "Opsis Appearance" plugin (separate download): automatic Light/Dark at sunrise/sunset, accent colour (also from the wallpaper), taskbar, coloured active-window border, corners, dark title bars, Mica/Acrylic backdrop, full restore.
~ Wallpaper: fixed the z-order on Windows 11 24H2/25H2/26H2 (the window was placed below the Windows wallpaper), stopped the flicker of the post-start re-checks, and WebView2 now recovers from GPU/renderer crashes or a temporarily missing runtime instead of showing a black screen.
~ Flicker: double buffering on every window/container and a single repaint on page/theme changes.
~ Low-end PCs (Low tier): decorative animations run 3x less often; the dock skips magnification/previews.
VersionNotes.2.0.0:
+ New app themes: Midnight, Forest, Dawn and High contrast (Settings → Theme).
+ New widgets: Now Playing (current media with play/pause/next/previous), Windows Notifications (with dismiss), Calendar (month view) and Bluetooth (paired devices).
+ Widgets: new "Full transparency (no panel)" option — no black/white panel behind the content at all.
+ Lock screen: new button to reset to the Windows default, and the wallpaper snapshot no longer includes the wallpaper's own clock/weather overlay.
+ Self-update: checks on every start and every 12 hours, downloads with SHA-256 verification and installs silently.
+ Safe mode after repeated failed startups, hardware profile (Low/Balanced/High) and rotating logs.
+ Ctrl+K (command palette) is now also an app launcher: search and open Start Menu and taskbar apps.
+ Tested on a simulated budget laptop (8GB RAM, 2 logical cores, half speed per core, no discrete GPU): Low profile auto-detected, ~0.5 GB total memory, smooth UI response.
~ System Monitor: each metric (CPU/RAM/Network/GPU) has its own color and visible gaps between the rings.
~ Fixed the selected performance button losing its blue highlight as soon as the mouse left it.
~ Cards on Personalization/Performance now share one width; wallpaper and widget settings moved from general Settings to their own tabs.
VersionNotes.1.9.12:
+ DeskStrip: the floating app dock now expands/shrinks smoothly when you pin or unpin an app instead of snapping instantly; icons now animate smoothly on hover (instead of jumping), play a small entrance animation when newly pinned, and bounce briefly when you launch one.
~ DeskStrip drag & drop actually works now: dropping a file onto an existing icon (not just empty space) pins it, and you can drag one icon onto another to reorder them.
~ DeskStrip now starts pre-filled with whatever is pinned to your real Windows taskbar the first time you enable it, instead of starting empty.
~ Fixed two DeskStrip bugs found right after shipping the taskbar pre-fill: a shortcut whose target path can't be read (like File Explorer's own pin) was silently dropped, and two different taskbar shortcuts that happen to launch the same program (e.g. a website pinned as its own app) were incorrectly treated as duplicates and merged into one, hiding one of them and showing a broken-looking icon for the other.
~ Fixed the License dialog: the header icon could overlap the "MIT License" title, and the license text's smaller block used a monospace font that looked like a plain text file instead of part of a designed dialog.
~ Fixed the Quick Settings widget's power-plan names showing as garbled text on Greek Windows (and likely other non-English installs) — the console output of the underlying system tool was being decoded with the wrong text encoding.
VersionNotes.1.9.11: ~ Fixed the black screen flash that could briefly flicker over the whole desktop the first time an animated wallpaper (Waves/Particles/Weather) appears, right after Opsis starts. Root cause: the wallpaper window's own background was shown for a frame or two before the animated content underneath it had actually been composited on screen. The window and its content are now revealed together, in one step, and the window's background now matches the wallpaper's own dark background color instead of plain black, so even a borderline frame is no longer visible as a flash.
VersionNotes.1.9.10: ~ Fixed a real conflict found in code review before it could be reported: resizing the outer edge of a zone that touches the screen's own edge (e.g. the left edge of the first column) could silently trigger the always-on magnetic half-screen snap instead of the new neighbor-resize, since the cursor sits right at the screen edge for that entire drag. Dragging to actually change a window's size no longer shows any snap preview, regardless of where that edge happens to be.
VersionNotes.1.9.9:
+ DeskZones: AquaSnap-style neighbor-tile auto-resize - resizing an already-snapped window by dragging its edge now also resizes the snapped neighbor that shares that edge, instead of leaving a gap or an overlap. Nothing about your saved zone layout is changed, only the currently-open windows.
+ New keyboard shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+arrow (no Alt) moves only the focus to the window in the adjacent zone, without moving any window - Ctrl+Alt+Shift+arrow still moves the window itself, unchanged.
+ Personalization tab redesigned: every section (icon atlas, cursors, DeskStrip, DeskSounds, theme packages, lock screen) now lives in its own visually separate card instead of a flat, continuous list.
~ A true 2-column layout for the narrower rows (icon/cursor slots) still needs the main window widened to ~1500px+ - not done this round, kept as a known follow-up rather than forced in at the current width.
VersionNotes.1.9.8:
~ Fixed a real bug, found live: on any page, once the mouse happened to be hovering a button/checkbox/label instead of empty space, scrolling with the wheel would silently stop working right there - it looked like the page got "stuck". Every page now keeps scrolling no matter what the cursor is over.
~ "Download and install News Crawler" in the installer is now checked by default (still skippable) - it was easy to forget and left the plugin out of date for a long time.
+ The installer now has a dedicated, shared dependencies page (same one the News Crawler installer uses): it shows exactly which of .NET 10 Desktop Runtime / WebView2 Runtime are already present, downloads only what's missing, and verifies each download carries a real Microsoft signature before running it. Replaces the old silent bundled copies, which also shrinks the installer.
+ Plugins can now be fully uninstalled from the About page, not just disabled - removes its files (immediately if possible, otherwise cleanly on the next startup if they're still in use).
VersionNotes.1.9.7:
+ New: "Match lock screen to wallpaper" in Personalization - takes an exact snapshot of your current live wallpaper (waves/video + overlay) and sets it as your Windows lock screen image, then keeps it in sync automatically every few minutes while the wallpaper is on (same file, no new UAC prompt).
~ Detection: if Windows resets the setting (an update or a settings change), Opsis notices on its next startup and asks with a plain pop-up whether to turn it back on - no silent re-elevation, no scheduled task.
VersionNotes.1.9.6:
+ New native widget: Quick Settings - volume, screen brightness (where the display supports it) and power-plan switching in one small panel, SeelenUI-inspired.
~ Internal: added a System Control service backing the new widget (NAudio for volume, WMI for brightness, powercfg for power plans).
VersionNotes.1.9.5:
+ Each plugin (e.g. Opsis News Crawler) now has its own Enabled toggle on its About-page card, separate from the blanket "Load plugins" switch.
~ Fixed a real bug: if the same plugin existed in two folders with different versions, the older one always won and an updated plugin never actually took effect - now the newer version is kept.
~ "Check for updates now" also reports missing dependencies (FFmpeg/WebView2) in the same pass.
+ New: "Follow Windows accent color" in Settings - reads your actual Windows accent color (Settings -> Personalization -> Colors) instead of a fixed palette.
~ Widget and page text now uses "Segoe UI Variable", the Windows 11 system font, for a slightly more modern look (falls back safely on Windows 10).
VersionNotes.1.9.4:
+ New: optional plugin system - Opsis can load add-ons with their own sidebar page, tray menu entries and an About-page card (help, usage, version history, license); ships with Opsis News Crawler, a scrolling news/market ticker bar, as the first plugin. Toggle with Settings -> Load plugins.
~ Sidebar: brand area redesigned into three lines (title, tagline, version) so the logo no longer shrinks when the sidebar is collapsed, and now lines up with the navigation icons.
~ Fixed faint antialiased edge lines on several controls' backgrounds and uneven borders on the collapsed sidebar's icon tiles.
~ "Check for updates once a month" now reads correctly in all 14 languages - the other 12 still said "once a day" after the interval itself was changed to monthly.
~ A page that fails to load now shows a short error message and logs it, instead of appearing blank.
~ Opsis now offers to set your real weather location once, instead of silently showing Athens' weather when none is set.
~ Fixed location search not finding cities typed in your own language (e.g. Greek) and not offering a choice when multiple cities share a name.
VersionNotes.1.9.3:
+ Weather wallpaper: temperature now shows with 1 decimal place, and wind moved onto the same line as the temperature instead of its own line below.
+ Weather wallpaper: real wave shape near the horizon (wind-driven, more pronounced at higher wind) instead of only sparkle texture - open water now reads as having actual swell, not just a flat reflective plane.
~ Weather wallpaper: rain-on-glass drops were technically rendering but far too small and faint to notice on a real desktop - sized up and brightened significantly.
~ Weather wallpaper: fixed an intermittent flicker right after the wallpaper appears, caused by the first frame rendering before real weather data had arrived and then visibly jumping once it did.
~ License window: redesigned with a proper header and visually separated sections instead of one flat wall of text; fixed the copyright line still saying the old app name.
~ Fixed the sidebar subtitle overflowing/getting cut off after the Opsis rename; now follows the same compact "tagline  ·  vX.X.X" pattern as GearWin's sidebar.
~ DeskContainers: more clearance between the title bar and the icon grid (a previous pass's increase apparently wasn't enough).
~ DeskZones: fixed the real cause of the persistent gap between adjacent zones - a floating-point rounding mismatch, not the zone spacing setting (which was already correctly set to zero).
~ Update checks now run monthly instead of daily, with a periodic re-check so a long-running session doesn't miss it by only checking once at startup.
= Looked into DeskContainers' drag-and-drop: it already copies (never moves) dropped files - verified in code, no change needed.
VersionNotes.1.9.2:
+ The "Transparency effects" toggle now also blurs the real Windows taskbar directly (same technique as the well-known TranslucentTB utility: asking DWM to blur behind the taskbar's own window, no code injection into Explorer) — more reliably visible than relying on Explorer picking up the registry change on its own. Applies automatically at startup to match whatever the setting is currently set to.
= Looked into going further (replicating Windhawk-style live UI restyling of other apps/Explorer) and deliberately did not: that requires DLL injection into dwm.exe/explorer.exe, real risk of taking down the whole desktop shell if it breaks, and per-Windows-build maintenance. Kept to the safe, non-injection approach per explicit instruction.
VersionNotes.1.9.1:
+ New: toggle Windows' own "Transparency effects" and "Fast startup" switches right from Settings — the exact same system settings as Windows' own Settings app, read/written directly in the registry so they stay in sync even if changed elsewhere.
~ Fixed a freeze when clicking the transparency checkbox: the live-apply broadcast was blocking the UI thread waiting for every open window on the system to respond; it's now fire-and-forget like it should be.
~ Fixed scrolling snapping back to the top on the Widgets, DeskZones and Personalization pages (and inside DeskContainers with many icons) whenever their list refreshed — same WinForms AutoScroll quirk already fixed elsewhere, now covered everywhere it happens.
~ System Monitor widget: the Network and GPU rings were nearly invisible at low readings (just a tiny dot) because their track was too faint — the ring is now always clearly visible, even at 0%.
~ RunLatest.bat was still launching the old .NET 8 build output; fixed to point at the current .NET 10 build.
VersionNotes.1.9.0:
+ Dark mode: scrollbars no longer render white — they now follow the app's light/dark theme everywhere (Windows' own documented dark-scrollbar technique, the same one File Explorer uses).
+ Upgraded the whole app from .NET 8 to .NET 10 (newer runtime, better performance) — still WinForms; a full switch to WPF/WPF-UI was considered and intentionally not done (see below).
= Not done: WPF-UI. It's a component library for WPF specifically, and this app is WinForms — using it for real would mean rewriting the whole UI layer in a different framework, not a visual tweak. Skipped per explicit instruction; the custom pill-buttons/sliders/checkboxes/shadows already added achieve a similar modern look without that risk.
VersionNotes.1.8.9:
+ Finished the MediaPlayerPro-inspired presentation pass: all sliders app-wide are now custom flat sliders (thin accent-colored track, circular thumb) instead of the old Windows TrackBar look.
+ Buttons are now properly pill-shaped (fully rounded) everywhere, and the active one in an Enable/Disable-style pair is now a solid accent-filled "hero" button (white text) instead of a faint tint.
+ Popup dialogs (Version History, rename, container settings, etc.) now have a real native drop shadow.
= Not done: a true custom-drawn scrollbar. Every scrollable panel in the app uses the real Windows scrollbar, and replacing it everywhere would mean rebuilding how scrolling itself works on every page — too large and risky a change to do blindly in this pass.
VersionNotes.1.8.8:
+ New custom checkbox style across the app (rounded box, accent fill, hand-drawn checkmark) inspired by MediaPlayerPro's presentation — used in Settings, DeskZones and the Wallpaper playlist.
+ Wallpaper Studio's video playlist rows redesigned: a colored left-edge strip now shows which videos are active, and the remove button has a proper round hover highlight.
~ Verified the white window-frame flash on page switch — 14 rapid page changes showed no flash after the v1.8.6 fix.
VersionNotes.1.8.7: + System Monitor widget redesigned: CPU/RAM/Network/GPU are now shown as four colored ring gauges (same visual style as the Disk widget) instead of stacked bars — a cleaner, more consistent look across widgets.
VersionNotes.1.8.6:
= Follow-up fixes from live testing of v1.8.5.
~ Fixed overlapping buttons in the DeskContainer settings window (rebuilt with auto-flowing rows that can't overlap regardless of text length).
+ Added a Quick Hide setting on the DeskZones page: double-click an empty spot on the desktop to hide/show icons (the feature already existed, it just had no on/off switch).
~ Properly fixed the white border around widgets this time (the previous fix only covered DeskContainers; widgets never re-applied it when their window handle was recreated).
~ More breathing room under the DeskContainer title bar.
~ Fixed a white window-frame flash near the top-left corner when switching pages.
~ Drag & drop now explicitly allows the needed messages through Windows' UIPI, in case the app is ever run elevated.
VersionNotes.1.8.5:
= Bug-fix and polish pass across widgets, DeskContainers, the Performance/DeskZones pages and the Weather wallpaper.
+ The wallpaper's clock/date/temperature overlay now also shows wind speed.
~ Fixed the rain "drops on glass" effect on the Weather wallpaper not reliably showing (frame-ordering bug).
~ Widget and DeskContainer opacity now fades only the background (real Windows blur-behind), not the text or icons on top.
~ Removed the thin white border/frame look around widgets and DeskContainers, and made the Disk widget's ring track less prominent.
+ The System Monitor widget now shows a small history graph under each row (CPU/RAM/Network/GPU).
+ Two new analog clock themes (Mono, Retro) and two new digital clock fonts/colors.
~ Fixed the active-widgets, active-containers and pinned-apps lists flickering every 2 seconds even when nothing had changed.
~ Fixed drag & drop onto a DeskContainer that already has icons in it (it previously only worked on an empty container).
+ DeskContainers can now be resized by dragging the corner, and their title's font and size are configurable.
~ Smoother roll-up animation for DeskContainers, and fixed a phantom scrollbar flash during it.
~ The container settings (☰) button now opens a proper tabbed settings window instead of a Fences-style flyout menu.
~ Fixed the Performance page scrolling back to the top every time its stats refreshed.
+ The Performance page now shows each stat's value next to its title instead of below it.
~ Fixed the DeskZones layout preview being slightly clipped on its right/bottom edge.
~ DeskZones now touch each other exactly, with no gap between adjacent zones (and the windows snapped into them touch too).
+ New "Transparency effects" and "Fast startup" (Windows) toggles on the Settings page.
VersionNotes.1.7.8:
= Small release: RAM percentage everywhere, a smoother sidebar and 12 more languages.
+ The RAM usage percentage now shows on the Dashboard System card (click it for details), in the Memory bar on the Performance page, in the status bar and in the System Monitor widget.
+ The two "CPU & RAM" and "GPU" history graphs at the bottom of the Performance page were removed.
+ The sidebar expands and collapses smoothly: the buttons follow the sidebar width frame by frame and the arrow button stays centred, with no ripples.
+ Opsis now speaks the same 14 languages as GearWin: Greek, English, German, French, Spanish, Korean, Chinese, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Portuguese, Turkish, Arabic and Hindi (Settings → Language). The wallpaper clock and date follow the chosen language.
+ Personalization: "Import icon pack" and "Set folder icon" are now on the same row.
Wallpaper.DesktopIntro: Shows your normal Windows wallpaper (a static picture or your slideshow) so that the clock, date and temperature can appear over it. This mode starts by itself when the animated wallpaper is off and the clock/date/temperature option is on.
